packets.question: Should matchStoreBranchSegmentReader be taught to serve MATCH_BASELINE_BRANCH_ID alongside root, or should the rewind mirror write onto root instead, given that the rewind-branch fold is unreachable for match streams today?

options.label: (a) teach matchStoreBranchSegmentReader to serve the baseline id alongside root
options.consequence: LIVE_PATH_BRANCH_IDS already treats root and the baseline id as one line, so the reader change keeps the mirror write where it is and leaves rows already written onto the baseline id readable; it is a product change to the match-store segment reader and widens what the live path serves.
options.effort: one bounded product slice inside the match-store segment reader plus its tests

options.label: (b) mirror onto root
options.consequence: Leaves the reader untouched and makes the mirror write land where the reader already looks, but changes where every future rewind branch is recorded and must reconcile rows already written onto the baseline id.
options.effort: one bounded product slice at the mirror write plus a reconciliation of already-written baseline rows

packets.agentRecommendation: Option (a): LIVE_PATH_BRANCH_IDS already treats root and the baseline id as one line, so serving both from the reader matches the contract that exists and does not move rows that were already written.
packets.revertCost: Low for (a) - a single reader predicate behind its own tests, revertable by one commit with no data migration. Higher for (b) - rows written onto root after the flip must be located and moved back, so a revert becomes a data reconciliation rather than a code revert.
